rationale: Record that repointing one semantic colour role crosses the render-assets-and-backends selector without changing anything the family is about. The Ink & Signal dark status palette could not carry success against danger by colour alone: --success (#3FCF77) and --danger (#FF5C4D) retained 13 percent of their separation under deuteranopia, and success against warning 25 percent under protanopia, which a contrast check cannot see because contrast is a luminance measure and this is a hue collision. The change adds one new ink, --ink-leaf-bright (#8CE8B0), and points the semantic --success role at it in the ink-signal token files and in the matching dark ThemePreset; every status pair now clears at worst 11.9 dE00. meter.green and --data-6 deliberately keep #3FCF77, because a meter is a level rather than a verdict, and that unchanged pairing is what proves only the semantic role moved. Light stays as shipped and the token file records why: no value fixes the light success/danger pair, the intuitive remedy is measurably worse, and a light-theme component therefore owes a second non-colour signal. The family is reached only because assets/design-system/** and core/view/** are watched paths: the selector matches three ink-signal token files and core/view/src/theme_presets.cpp. No renderer, canvas, Skia or Dawn backend, asset pipeline, importer, DesignIR schema, capture path or Vellum-owned source changes, and the only test verdict that moves is the theme-preset assertion that names the new value. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
